title: IndoBias: A Dual Track Culturally Grounded Benchmark for LLMs Bias Evaluation in Indonesian Languages
reasoning: The benchmark includes 'Ideology and Religion' as one of its five core bias domains. It specifically evaluates model biases and stereotypes regarding 29 religious identities in Indonesia, covering both institutional religions (e.g., Islam, Catholicism) and local belief systems (e.g., Kejawen, Sunda Wiwitan).
